details.biography: “I consider my self a ‘hands-on’ supervisor with a ‘roll-up-the-sleeves’ work ethic, and take pride in committing all of my energy, resources and sound acumen to each and every project, big or small.”With more than 100 feature film credits, Toon has been lending his creative talents to motion picture soundtracks for over twenty-five years. He received his BFA from CalArts in 1987, where his work-study job in the film school sound department helped him land a position with Danetracks. After climbing up the ranks to become a Supervising Sound Editor, Toon relocated to Walt Disney Studios where he was based for 17 years. He joined Formosa Features in the summer of 2013. Spanning a diverse range of genres, Toon moves seamlessly between animation, horror, comedy and more.
details.name: Todd Toon
